relationship: SRC-023 (VedaWeb strata.json) is a transcription of SRC-026 (Arnold 1905). They are one source, not two.
effect_on_status: Any claim citing both is single-sourced. Chronological readings of the strata are capped at PROVISIONAL.
notes: Stated in rigveda/TEI/vedaweb_corpus.tei, biblFull xml:id=strata: compiled by Gunkel and Ryan from Arnold, Vedic Metre in its Historical Development, Cambridge 1905.

relationship: The Zurich lemma layer is distributed inside the VedaWeb repository. Retrieving the repository is one retrieval event, not two.
effect_on_status: No effect: the lemma layer and the repository are cited together throughout.
notes: zurich.xlsx and the TEI token layer carry the same annotation; the TEI was used because it aligns tokens to padas.

relationship: Partially independent. The Zurich lemmatisation is a modern analysis; the padapatha is the ancient Sakalya word-analysis. They agree on segmentation but the padapatha is unaccented at the ambiguous points and cannot disambiguate pur- from puras / pura.
effect_on_status: Supports PUR-010 as a genuine recall check. Does not make PUR-003 double-sourced, because the padapatha cannot confirm the 48 ambiguous cases.
notes: See PUR-009 and PUR-010.

relationship: Arnold's Popular stratum and the book-order instrument are not independent measures of lateness: 61.3% of Popular-stratum tokens sit in book 10, and book 10 is 46.7% Popular.
effect_on_status: A claim resting on agreement between the two instruments is single-sourced at the late end.
notes: Recorded as PUR-021. This is the specific trap that produced correction C-05 in 01-INHERITED.

relationship: The Zurich lemmatisation and the Grassmann gloss travel together in the same annotation layer. A claim that cites the lemma and a claim that cites the meaning are one source, not two.
effect_on_status: Any river identification in 03-REGISTERS/domain-e-hydronyms.csv rests on the Grassmann gloss alone and is capped at PROVISIONAL. Recorded as DME-022.
notes: matched_lemmata.json carries Grassmann's German gloss keyed to the same lemma id that the TEI token layer points at. The identification of e.g. kúbhā- with the Kabul river is Grassmann's, not a measurement.

relationship: Restatement of DEP-001 for this unit: the stratum codes used in DME-008 to DME-010 are VedaWeb's transcription of Arnold 1905.
effect_on_status: DME-020 is capped at PROVISIONAL partly on this ground. DME-008 and DME-009 stay VERIFIED because they are counts of the codes, not readings of them.
notes: The distinction is the one CLAUDE.md draws: a count is VERIFIED, a claim inheriting a single framework is PROVISIONAL.

relationship: The retroflexion classification in DME-003 to DME-007 depends on the Zurich lemma citation form, which is a modern normalisation. Word-initial position, in particular, is a property of the citation form and not directly of any attested text token.
effect_on_status: DME-007 stays VERIFIED as a statement about the lemma inventory. It would need re-checking against surface forms before being restated as a claim about the recited text.
notes: Sandhi produces surface retroflexes at word boundaries that the lemma layer normalises away. The claim is scoped to lemmas for that reason, and says so.

relationship: Both trace to Krishnamurti 2003. Glottolog's North Dravidian node cites Krishnamurti 2003 and no other work (nort2698/md.ini, subrefs), and so do its Central and South Dravidian nodes; DravLex's cognate coding lists Krishnamurti 2003 among its five underlying sources (cldf/sources.bib). Krishnamurti 2003 has never been read in this project: it stands at 'Named, not read' (IH-237, 01-INHERITED/claude-project-handoff.md L451).
effect_on_status: Glottolog is NOT independent confirmation of the North Dravidian subgroup; it is a re-encoding of one book. Any claim that 'the standard classification and the comparative dataset agree' is single-sourced and capped at PROVISIONAL. It also means the cognate dataset is not independent of the hypothesis it is used to test here, which is why DMB-020 is reported as a bound and not as a test.
notes: The one place the dependency does NOT hold: the Kurux-Malto node below North Dravidian cites Kobayashi and Tirkey 2017 at pages 11-14, a different author and a different work. The lower node therefore has a second source; the top node, the one that attaches Brahui, does not.

relationship: DravLex's cognate judgements list Burrow and Emeneau 1961, the first edition of the Dravidian Etymological Dictionary, among their sources. SRC-037 is DEDR, the 1984 second edition, which is unreachable (HOLD-002).
effect_on_status: DravLex gives partial and indirect access to the DED cognate judgements for 100 concepts across 20 varieties. It does NOT lift HOLD-002: it carries no entry numbers, no etymologies, no Old Indo-Aryan comparanda and no reconstruction, which are the things HOLD-002 needs. Claims requiring a DEDR entry number stay HELD.
notes: Recorded so that a later reader does not treat SRC-049 as having closed HOLD-002. It narrows the hold's scope for one specific question - relative cognate sharing among attested varieties - and for nothing else.

relationship: The retrieved DEDR table is a re-parse of the DSAL digitization of Burrow and Emeneau 1984. DSAL is EGRESS_BLOCKED, so the intermediate stage cannot be inspected.
effect_on_status: Counts over the retrieved table are VERIFIED as counts over that table. Any assertion about the printed dictionary is capped at PROVISIONAL.
notes: cldf/references.csv row ID=dedr gives the URL and Editor=Aryaman Arora.

relationship: DEDR and CDIAL are not independent. Turner cites DED throughout, and Burrow and Emeneau's Dravidian Borrowings from Indo-Aryan is built against Indo-Aryan; several CDIAL Dravidian attributions are credited to Burrow's own papers (BSOAS 12, TPS 1945, TPS 1946).
effect_on_status: A word attributed to Dravidian by Turner and found in DEDR is ONE source, not two. No confirmation may be claimed from their agreement.
notes: Visible in the brackets counted for DE-M-002, e.g. CDIAL 16 and 50, both 'Burrow, BSOAS 12, 365'.

relationship: Turner's Munda attributions are largely credited to Kuiper (PMWS). Kuiper 1991 and the PMWS volume are unretrieved.
effect_on_status: DE-M-003 counts Turner reporting Kuiper. The 55 Munda arrows are not 55 independent judgements.
notes: CDIAL 117, 629, 1012, 1111, 3261, 6085 all cite PMWS or Kuiper by name.

relationship: Restatement of DEP-001 for domain A, with the dependency now measured rather than asserted. strata.json is Gunkel and Ryan's transcription of Arnold 1905; and DA-M-005 puts Cramer's V between book number and stratum code at 0.463 over 39,833 padas, with a book-majority classifier at 50.5% against a 24.7% baseline.
effect_on_status: Every chronological reading of the strata stays capped at PROVISIONAL, as DEP-001 already required. DA-M-005 to DA-M-008 are counts of the codes and stay VERIFIED. What DEP-021 adds is the size of the entanglement: book order is not a second instrument that could confirm a stratum claim, it is 46% of the stratum claim.
notes: DA-M-005, DA-M-006, DA-M-007. DEP-004 asserted the Popular/book-10 case; this generalises it to all five strata and all ten books.

relationship: Within stanza_properties.json, Oldenberg's marked set and Wuest's marked set are near-identical: Jaccard 0.836, phi 0.904, 641 stanzas shared out of 699 and 709 (DA-M-010).
effect_on_status: Oldenberg 1888/1909-12 and Wuest 1928 count as ONE instrument, not two, wherever independence is being counted. Any claim citing both as corroboration is single-sourced.
notes: Wuest 1928 is Stilgeschichte und Chronologie des Rgveda, forty years after Oldenberg's Prolegomena. Whether Wuest took Oldenberg's list over, or reached it independently, is not decided here - only that in this digest the two sets are the same set. Reading the two works would settle it and neither is retrievable (HOLD-006).

relationship: Arnold 1897 (Sketch of the Historical Grammar, in stanza_properties.json) and Arnold 1905 (Vedic Metre, in strata.json) agree at phi = 0.825, the highest pair in the matrix; 86.8% of Sketch-marked stanzas are Popular-stratum stanzas (DA-M-011).
effect_on_status: Arnold 1897 is NOT an independent check on Arnold 1905 and must never be cited as one. The five markings in stanza_properties.json are four instruments at most and, after DEP-022, three that are not Arnold's.
notes: Same author, eight years apart, on the same corpus. The high agreement is the expected result and is recorded so that the file's five columns are not miscounted as five witnesses.

relationship: versions/vnh.csv and versions/aufrecht.csv both descend from Barend A. van Nooten and Gary B. Holland's electronic data entry, per the TEI sourceDesc of both files; aufrecht.csv was converted and revised by Detlef Eichler for GRETIL and both were then modified by Gunkel and Ryan.
effect_on_status: DA-M-024, DA-M-025 and DA-M-026 compare two states of ONE digital lineage. They measure the restoration as its editors made it; they do not compare two independent witnesses to the text, and no manuscript variant is involved anywhere in this unit.
notes: The label 'Aufrecht' names Aufrecht's 1877 printed edition. The file is not Aufrecht's setting; it is van Nooten and Holland's keyboarding of it. Preservation is not authorship (constitution 4.V) applies to digitisers too.

relationship: The metrical restoration and Arnold's stratification are both metrical instruments applied to the same text. DA-M-027 finds restoration heaviest in the Archaic stratum (+1.352 syllables per stanza) and lightest in the Popular (+0.981).
effect_on_status: DA-M-027 is VERIFIED as a measurement and is NOT independent evidence that the Archaic stratum is older. Any inference from restoration load to date is circular through metre and is refused here; BR-A-002.
notes: The two instruments read the same signal. A genuinely independent test would need a non-metrical diagnostic, and this unit has one - the arrangement analysis - which is silent on date by construction.

relationship: The Zurich morphological annotation is the annotation layer of the same Zurich group whose members appear in the compilation of stanza_properties.json (Salvatore Scarlata, per the TEI respStmt), and it is the class of data Hellwig et al. 2021 analysed.
effect_on_status: Using the Zurich annotation as an instrument and then citing Hellwig et al. 2021 as an independent check on the result would be circular. DA-M-031 to DA-M-033 are reported as RAW and UNCONTROLLED for that reason, and are not offered as either confirming or refuting Hellwig et al.
notes: The exact relation cannot be pinned without reading the paper, which is abstract-only here (SRC-082, HOLD-009). The connector truncates the author list to 'Oliver Hellwig et al.', so even the co-authorship this unit was told to expect is unverified. Recorded as a dependency to be respected, not as one that is measured.
